issues.legal_issue: An eviction decree remains exempt from rent-control execution restrictions when the eviction suit was filed during the building’s exemption period, even if the decree was passed after that period ended.
material_facts: The building was completed in March 1960 and fell within the class of buildings covered by a government exemption from the rent-control restrictions for five years from completion.
The landlord filed an eviction suit in January 1963, within that five-year period, and obtained an eviction decree in August 1969, after the period had ended.
The executing court refused execution on the ground that the decree did not meet the exemption conditions; the High Court held the decree executable.
issues.conclusion: The suit had to be filed during the exemption period, but the decree did not have to be passed during that period. The decree was exempt from the restrictions on execution, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 13 of the Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949 restricts eviction in execution of a decree except as permitted by that section; section 3 empowers the Government to exempt buildings or classes of buildings from provisions of the Act. Under the notification dated July 30, 1965, the relevant timing condition was that the eviction suit be instituted during the exemption period; no deadline was prescribed for passing the decree. The Court read the notification in light of its language and purpose: requiring the decree to be passed within the period would make the separate suit-filing condition redundant and could defeat the exemption where a suit was filed near the period’s end. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: rent_control_eviction_decree_execution and building_within_exempted_construction_class and suit_filed_during_exemption_period and decree_passed_after_exemption_period

predicates.rent_control_eviction_decree_execution: The proceeding concerns execution of a decree ordering a tenant’s eviction where rent-control restrictions would otherwise govern execution.
predicates.building_within_exempted_construction_cl: The building belongs to a class of newly constructed buildings granted a time-limited exemption from rent-control restrictions.
predicates.suit_filed_during_exemption_period: The landlord instituted the eviction suit while the building’s exemption period was still running.
predicates.decree_passed_after_exemption_period: The eviction decree was passed after the building’s exemption period had ended.

issues.definition: When an execution proceeding concerns an eviction decree for a building in an exempted construction class, and the landlord filed suit during the exemption period but obtained the decree afterward, the decree is exempt from rent-control execution restrictions.
